about: IDs that a companion specification proposes and the spine does not register. GATE-links reports each as pending, not as a failure, while its entry is here. W0-T10 (spine revision 3) registers or declines each ID and then deletes its entry; `node scripts/verify-links.mjs --strict` fails while any entry remains. An entry is itself a failure once the spine registers its ID, or once nothing that is scanned uses it. Run IDs that a task lists in proposed_ids are pending through tracker/tasks.yaml and are not repeated here.

proposals.note: The executions behind docs/waves/W0-exit.md: the review queue, the spikes, the keep/kill rules, the two planted-fault self-checks, GATE-privacy and the fast lane at the commit W1 starts from. Spine section 9.5 registers no run for W0-T11; the next spine revision registers or declines it.

The replay of the witnesses of SP-1.1, SP-1.4 and SP-1.5 in plain integers, which the specimen label needs before it may show REFUTED: the three W0 Z3 runs behind them print a model and no replay. Spine section 9.5 registers no run for W1-T16; the next spine revision registers or declines it.
